body: From the DM-176 review (orchestrator, this run): fix and pin — (1) a redundant agent `active_ms` self-report (plain delta or inconsistent event) on an attempt whose work the host already covers with placed spans blanks ticket and run T (partial_coverage); do not count a refused agent record as a gap when the host reports placed spans for the same identity (efficiency.ts runScopes `refused`, timingActivity.ts spanOf before preferHost; repro %TEMP%/dm176-review/adv3.ts G1/G1b). (2) Full-run efficiency read is tickets x run records when run-level host spans keep arriving (7.7 s at 120 tickets/12k observations, perf2.ts): narrow the reprojection trigger to records that can reach a ticket's sample, and add a perf case at 200 tickets. Also pin the cohort-frozen-at-dispatch cases (adv4.ts).
